title: FocusVTC: Efficient and High-Performance Visual Text Compression with Adaptive Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.36651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-context reasoning in large language models incurs substantial computation and memory costs. Visual text compression (VTC) reduces input length by rendering text as images, but fixed-resolution rendering creates a compression-performance trade-off: low DPI saves tokens at the expense of legibility, whereas high DPI spends tokens on irrelevant content. We introduce FocusVTC, which breaks this trade-off through adaptive resolution while preserving general multimodal capabilities. It combines compressed low-DPI global views with selective region enhancement, integrating enhanced views into ongoing reasoning. We construct 29.4K high-quality Reasoning-Evidence Localization (REL) chain-of-thought examples (REL-CoT) that link reasoning traces to page indices and bounding boxes. Multi-resolution REL supervised fine-tuning (REL-SFT) teaches the model to localize relevant regions, and Group Relative Policy Optimization learns when to enhance

translated_title: FocusVTC：基于自适应分辨率的高效高性能视觉文本压缩
translated_abstract: 大语言模型中的长上下文推理会带来巨大的计算和内存开销。视觉文本压缩通过将文本渲染为图像来减少输入长度，但固定分辨率的渲染造成了压缩与性能之间的权衡：低DPI虽然节省了token却牺牲了可读性，而高DPI则将token浪费在不相关的内容上。我们提出了FocusVTC，它通过自适应分辨率打破了这种权衡，同时保留了通用的多模态能力。该方法将压缩的低DPI全局视图与选择性区域增强相结合，并将增强后的视图整合到正在进行的推理过程中。我们构建了29.4K高质量的推理证据定位（REL）链式思维示例（REL-CoT），将推理轨迹与页面索引和边界框相关联。多分辨率REL监督微调（REL-SFT）教会模型定位相关区域，而组相对策略优化（GRPO）则学习何时进行区域增强。
tldr: FocusVTC通过自适应分辨率的视觉文本压缩方法，将低DPI全局视图与选择性区域增强相结合，并利用REL-CoT数据、监督微调和强化学习训练模型定位和增强相关区域，从而在保持多模态能力的同时高效解决长上下文推理中的压缩与性能权衡问题。
